title: Guide frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter at the top of content/guides/<id>.md.

id.description: Unique guide id, must equal the file name without the .md extension.

title.description: Display title shown in the UI.

description.description: Short summary shown in cards and search results.

icon.description: Optional emoji or short symbol used as a decorative icon.

order.description: Optional ascending sort key. Guides without order fall back to alphabetical id order.
